payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is a frog visibly positioned inside the toilet bowl, below the rim, rather than merely overlapping the opening in the image?
node.criteria: complete: a frog is visibly within the bowl interior and positioned below the rim, with its placement supported by its relation to the rim/interior. partial: a frog is present at the toilet but only partly inside, or its position relative to the rim/interior is ambiguous. absent: no frog has been added at the toilet. unknown: image evidence is insufficient to assess the frog's position relative to the rim/interior. Cite the visible positional evidence; frogs on the lid or floor do not establish placement inside the bowl.
node.binding: The requested frog placement relative to the toilet bowl rim and interior.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.
